description: Holds branch review fl movement detail records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review fl movement detail records for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review fl movement detail.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review fl movement detail.
columns.business_meaning: Branch Review FL Movement Detail identifier

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review fl movement detail.

columns.name: fl_movement_id
columns.description: Fl movement id of the branch review fl movement detail.

columns.name: team_member_id
columns.description: Team member id of the branch review fl movement detail.

columns.name: movement_type
columns.description: Movement type of the branch review fl movement detail.

columns.name: influencer_id
columns.description: Influencer id of the branch review fl movement detail.

relationships.description: Each branch review fl movement detail references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: movement_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Columns movement_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
common_queries: Branch Review FL Movement Detail by month
Recent branch review fl movement detail
Branch Review FL Movement Detail by branch review header
Branch Review FL Movement Detail count by movement type

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewFLMovementDetail (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review fl movement detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
